text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I'd like to go to the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In a mountain lodge... I felt like sitting 
by the fireplace. With a big white dog by 
my side, of course.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Rocking in an armchair while toasting 
marshmallows to eat. Hehe, that sounds 
like so much fun...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Did I say something strange just now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart seems so exhausted that she's 
on the verge of trying to escape reality. 
It might be time to rethink her upcoming 
schedule.
